High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur

sentences.text:
Shri J.B. Kasat, Advocate for the appellant in the appea
 Shri C.R. Najbile, Advocate for respondent nos. 1a to 1g
 2/cross-objector/applicants.

Coram: Pravin S. Patil, J.
Dated : 08/09/2025.

By this application, the applicants are seeking condonation of delay of 1577 days in filing the Cross-
objection in the present appeal.

2. It is seen from the record that the appeal is filed by the Acquiring Body bearing appeal no.425 of
2019 has been admitted by this Court on 26.10.2018.
3.  As such, considering this fact, there is huge delay in filing the present application.

However, the applicant in paragraph 6 has made a statement as under :
"6.

The applicants are further relying upon the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court reported in 2014 (9) Scale 446 Imrat Lal and others vs. Land Acquisition Officer, in which the Hon'ble Apex Court has condone of delay 1110 days by not allowing the interest on the enhance compensation for the delayed period.

5. Therefore, with the aforesaid understanding, the application is allowed.
Delay stands condoned.

The application is allowed and disposed of.
